cover.desc: Full color, and deliberately the coldest cover of the run — no lamp-yellow anywhere. A school stairwell shot from high above, looking straight down the well: the square spiral of steel railings dropping away flight after flight, grey-green painted concrete, a tall dusty window throwing flat white daylight across one landing. On that landing, small in the frame and about three metres apart, two figures: Nagi with her back to the wall and her bag against her leg, Itsuki near the door with one hand on the push-bar, not facing each other. Neither is doing anything dramatic. Two floors below, tiny and irrelevant, a couple of other students are going up the stairs. The palette is institutional — grey, chalk-white, cold blue shadow, the green of the railings. The building is enormous and the space between the two of them is about a metre and a half. It should look like a photograph nobody meant to take.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: enormous grin, arms thrown wide — the full apparatus
chars.pose: kicking the classroom door open, forty minutes late

panels.bg: classroom doorway, Monday morning, speed lines, startled students — compose to echo Ch.1 page 3 panel 1
panels.action: Monday. The old entrance, executed perfectly.

dialogue.text: Present! Spiritually, I've been here since seven!

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: grin holding, arms still up

panels.bg: classroom, students looking up from their desks, nobody moving yet
panels.action: Half a second of nothing.

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: laughing — and watching him while he does it

panels.bg: classroom, laughter starting up a beat late all round him
panels.action: The room laughs. It laughs slightly after it should. One person in the room notices the gap.

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: >_<, detective cap back on, string and pins, tiny body huge head
chars.pose: chibi, gesturing at a fresh blackboard diagram at lunch

chars.name: aya
chars.expression: chibi, seated front row, notebook out, fully re-enlisted

panels.bg: empty classroom at lunch, blackboard covered in new red string, chaos lines, starburst screentone
panels.action: The investigation reopens. Comedy peak, and it is the last one in the chapter.

dialogue.text: The mood is BACK. But it's a DIFFERENT mood.

chars.name: aya
chars.expression: chibi, hand up like a student

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: chibi, grave, pointing at the board

panels.bg: blackboard, chaos lines, sparkle tone
panels.action: Two amateurs, one correct conclusion, no idea what to do with it.

chars.name: aya
chars.expression: normal proportions, suddenly not playing
chars.pose: pen down, looking at the board properly

panels.bg: empty classroom, blackboard, flat afternoon light — chibi register dropped
panels.action: Different weird. She does not say it out loud.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: distracted, going through the motions
chars.pose: dragging a wet mop across the floor at completely the wrong angle

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: stacking chairs

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: wiping the blackboard, back turned

panels.bg: classroom after hours, cleaning duty, desks stacked, low afternoon light
panels.action: Cleaning duty. He is doing it wrong in a way that would take four seconds to fix.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: half-turned, mouth already open, entirely on reflex

panels.bg: blackboard, chalk dust, afternoon light
panels.action: The instruction voice comes out before anything can stop it. It gets two words.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: mouth closing, going absolutely still
chars.pose: back to the board, cloth up

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: head snapping up, mop stopped

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: chair half-lifted, staring

panels.bg: classroom, four people, dead silence, dust in the afternoon light
panels.action: Two words of a private language, in a room where nobody speaks it.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: flat, blank, already turning back to the board

panels.bg: blackboard, chalk dust
panels.action: She does not explain it. There is no version of explaining it. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: gone bright red to the ears, mopping furiously

panels.bg: classroom floor, water, afternoon light
panels.action: He does not fix the angle. He would rather die than fix the angle now.

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: looking from one to the other, calculating

chars.name: aya
chars.expression: in the doorway with her bag, having seen the last three seconds of it

panels.bg: classroom, the two of them at opposite ends of the room and working very hard at it
panels.action: Two witnesses, one room, no theory that fits.

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: quiet, no bit anywhere on him

chars.name: aya
chars.expression: shaking her head slightly

panels.bg: classroom, low light
panels.action: Neither of them makes a joke about it. That is how the reader knows it is bad.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: eating alone with a book open, entirely composed
chars.pose: at her desk by the window, lunch box on her lap

panels.bg: classroom at lunch, bright, everybody else in clusters, one empty desk on either side of her
panels.action: Tuesday. This is what every lunch for two years has looked like.

chars.name: aya
chars.expression: cheerful, not asking anything
chars.pose: dragging the next desk over and sitting down on it backwards, unpacking her lunch

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: looking up, guarded

panels.bg: classroom, window seat, bright noise all round
panels.action: She does not ask to sit down. She sits down.

chars.name: aya
chars.expression: already eating, not looking at her, saying it to the lunch box
chars.pose: holding out a full second container

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: recognising the shape of it

panels.bg: two desks, two lunches, bright window light
panels.action: It is a lie and both of them know it is a lie, and it is exactly what the tofu man says when he leaves a crate on her counter.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: deploying the thing that has worked for two solid years

chars.name: aya
chars.expression: eating

panels.bg: classroom, window seat, lunchtime
panels.action: The door-closer. It has a hundred per cent success rate.

dialogue.text: You don't have to do this.

chars.name: aya
chars.expression: entirely untroubled, mouth full, not investigating anything
chars.pose: chopsticks going back into her own lunch

panels.bg: window light, blurred classroom
panels.action: She does not argue with it. She does not ask what is wrong. She simply does not leave.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — head down over her book
chars.pose: eating, the second container now open in front of her

chars.name: aya
chars.expression: reading something on her phone, elbow on the desk

panels.bg: classroom, two desks pushed together at the window, bright ordinary noise, nobody talking
panels.action: Twenty minutes of somebody sitting near her and wanting nothing. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: mouthing something to himself, jaw working
chars.pose: alone at the sinks in the corridor, hands under the tap

panels.bg: school corridor sinks, Wednesday, grey light, nobody about
panels.action: He has been building a sentence for two days and it keeps coming out in the wrong order.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: grim, decided
chars.pose: looking at himself in the strip of mirror

panels.bg: corridor mirror, grey light
panels.action: He has never once had to plan a thing he was going to say. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: low, quick, not doing a voice
chars.pose: catching her at the corridor corner as she passes, half a step in front of her

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: stopping, bag against her leg

panels.bg: corridor corner by the stairwell door, end of day, orange light
panels.action: Nine words, and the last four are the only ones that matter.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: small in frame, back against the wall
chars.pose: standing on the landing, bag against her leg

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: small in frame, by the door

panels.bg: the school stairwell from high up the well: square spiral of steel railings dropping away, painted concrete, one tall dusty window, flat grey daylight. Two floors below, two other students going up. ART NOTE: everything spoken on this page and the next three is at whisper volume — the space carries sound and both of them know it.
panels.action: A metre and a half apart, in a concrete tube that broadcasts everything, in a building full of people.

panels.bg: two floors down, a fire door swinging shut; the sound going up the well
panels.action: Everything down there is audible up here. It works in both directions.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: swallowing, starting
chars.pose: letting the door close, taking one step in

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: waiting, guarded

panels.bg: stairwell landing, grey window light
panels.action: He opens with the two words he rehearsed.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: shutting like a door

panels.bg: stairwell, grey light, flat screentone
panels.action: Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: earnest, low, meaning every word of it kindly
chars.pose: one hand out slightly, not touching her

panels.bg: stairwell landing, railings, grey light
panels.action: He is not being careless. He is being kind, at close range, with no aim.

dialogue.text: You went down. On the floor.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: adding, the way he always adds, and this is the one that does it

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: hearing it

panels.bg: stairwell, grey window light, the well dropping away behind them
panels.action: His failure mode when he lies and his failure mode when he cares are the same failure mode. He keeps adding.

dialogue.text: You can't keep doing it alone.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: nothing moving, and behind the eyes the exact word she has spent fourteen months not being called

panels.bg: flat grey screentone, hard window light
panels.action: He has told her, gently, that he watched her fail. Silent.

panels.bg: two floors below, small in the frame: two students going up the stairs, talking about nothing, entirely unaware
panels.action: Somewhere below, school carries on at normal volume.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: completely level, not raising her voice by a single degree
chars.pose: still against the wall, hands at her sides

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: taking it directly in the chest

panels.bg: stairwell landing, grey light, railings
panels.action: She does not argue with him. She takes his own sentence, turns it a hundred and eighty degrees, and hands it back.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: the real face, for about one second — flat, gutted, no catchlights

panels.bg: stairwell, grey light, flat screentone
panels.action: One second of the truth. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: the whole apparatus coming up — crescent eyes, big catchlights, the grin, hands raised — switched on deliberately and pointed at her
chars.pose: palms up, shoulders loose, the classroom shrug

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: watching it happen to her

panels.bg: stairwell landing, grey light. ART NOTE: this bubble is a normal SPEECH bubble in a page of whisper bubbles — he has gone up to classroom volume in a stairwell where everything has been said at a breath.
panels.action: He does not shout at her. He does something worse. He gives her the face that Gonda gets.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: grin intact, already turning, eyes not in it at all
chars.pose: hand going back to the push-bar

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — out of focus behind him

panels.bg: stairwell door, grey light. ART NOTE: normal speech bubble again.
panels.action: For nine chapters the exit line has been another night, Thursdays, again. This is what he says to people who do not know him.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: eyes widening — the second time in nine chapters

panels.bg: stairwell, grey light, flat screentone
panels.action: She knows exactly what he just demoted her to. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: stopped, hand flat on the door, back turned, the grin gone the instant she could no longer see it

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — behind him, small, still against the wall

panels.bg: stairwell door from behind him, grey light. ART NOTE: compose to echo Ch.1 page 16 panel 2 and Ch.3 page 14 panel 2 — hand flat on the frame, back turned, waiting.
panels.action: Every previous time he has stood in a doorway with his back to her, she has said the word. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — small, alone on the landing

panels.bg: the stairwell from high above, the fire door swinging shut, the square spiral of railings, one small figure on one landing
panels.action: She doesn't. He goes. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: unreadable, upright
chars.pose: still on the landing, bag against her leg, not having moved

panels.bg: stairwell, grey window light, empty
panels.action: Some minutes.

chars.name: aya
chars.expression: coming up the stairs, seeing her, and not changing her face at all
chars.pose: hand on the rail, stopping two steps down

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not looking at her

panels.bg: stairwell landing, grey light
panels.action: She does not ask what happened. She does not look at the door he went through.

chars.name: aya
chars.expression: settling onto the step, bag on her knees, getting out her phone
chars.pose: sitting down two steps below her

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — head down
chars.pose: sliding down the wall to sit on the landing

panels.bg: stairwell, two girls on two levels, grey window light, empty school
panels.action: Presence, offered without a single question attached to it.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: opening her mouth on the no she has used for two years, and not using it

panels.bg: stairwell wall, grey light, flat screentone
panels.action: She has spent her whole life carrying a number, and the number just went up. It does not feel like relief.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: grim, scrubbing far too hard
chars.pose: on his knees at the kitchen sink unit at ten at night, cloth in both hands

panels.bg: the Nomura apartment kitchen, one lamp, dishes already done, Sōta's futon visible in the next room
panels.action: Wednesday night. He has cleaned the same twenty centimetres of worktop four times.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: in the doorway in her pyjamas, arms folded, entirely level

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not turning round

panels.bg: kitchen doorway, one lamp, dark flat beyond
panels.action: One line. She has been reading him since she was nine.

dialogue.text: You only clean when it's bad.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: working, ordinary
chars.pose: carrying a stack of baskets across the changing room

panels.bg: Kotobuki-yu at 7:30pm on Thursday, warm lamp, steam through the bath door, two customers' shoes in the rack
panels.action: Thursday. The building is warm, the water is right, and everything is exactly where it should be.

chars.name: fusae
chars.expression: in the chair, eyes shut, saying nothing about anything

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: wiping the counter

panels.bg: rest area, the massage chair humming again, warm lamp, fish clock at 8:52
panels.action: Fusae-san notices that there is one fewer person in the building. She does not mention it.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: half-lidded, working
chars.pose: restacking a shelf that does not need restacking

panels.bg: changing room, warm lamp, fish clock at 10:41
panels.action: She works exactly as hard as she works on any other night.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — reaching up

panels.bg: empty changing room, baskets stacked, fish clock at 11:34, the sandals squared at the base of the counter
panels.action: Closing. 11:34, the same as every night.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: level, unreadable
chars.pose: standing in the middle of the empty changing room, cloth in one hand, looking at the entrance

panels.bg: the frosted glass of the front door, dark street beyond it, no shape behind it, warm lamp
panels.action: She looks at the door once. Once is all she does. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: already turning away
chars.pose: walking toward the bath hall with the cloth

panels.bg: changing room into the bath doorway, steam, warm lamp
panels.action: First Thursday since the third chapter with nobody else in the building. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: n/a — hand only
chars.pose: her hand resting on the boiler shutdown valve, and then coming off it without turning it

panels.bg: boiler room, the valve, bare bulb, the gauge steady in the green
panels.action: It costs money to keep it lit for nobody. She takes her hand off the valve. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — back turned, reaching up
chars.pose: lifting the blue-handled brush down off its hook on the tiled wall

panels.bg: bath hall corner, the shelf, the empty hook, the red bucket below with three brushes in it
panels.action: She takes it down and lays it beside a second bucket she has already filled. Silent.

panels.bg: ART NOTE: compose to match Chapter 1, page 1 exactly — same angle, same crop, same distance. A shuttered shopping street at night, the tiled bathhouse facade, the chimney venting steam into a black sky, one lit lamp over the entrance. The single difference: the indigo noren is still hanging, forty minutes after closing, and the fish clock through the glass reads 12:19.
panels.action: She does not know how to apologise. She knows how to leave a door open. Final panel, and it is the first page of the series with nothing written on it.
